I’ve read the full static review and verified its hash. I’ll limit revision 3 to the five requested items: argv-bound deadlines, trace-filter accounting, input verification, a no-store strace smoke, and authority-boundary documentation. I won’t run Phase E or import AF, CM, or Chronicle.The smoke test caught a real transport defect: Node’s `stdio: "pipe"` uses a socket, which strace cannot reopen through `/dev/fd/3`. The checker correctly reported `INCOMPLETE`.

I’ll fix that fd/strace path within item 4 using a real shell pipe, preserving strace’s exit status and the unchanged sandbox. No privilege or seccomp relaxation is needed.All four gates passed at commit `e3f07c16`: check-prep, no-op with strace smoke, forced kill, and deadline-negative.

The changed launcher ran the mock under 600s/10s. Its receipt recorded those actual values, and the checker refused them against the manifest’s 1800s/30s—even though the mock stream had a normal terminal record. No store or AF/CM/Chronicle import was used.
